'''Ashes of Korr''' was a debris belt<ref name="Wizards" /> in the third [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] position<ref name="TEA" /> of the [[Horuset system]], around the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Horuset]].<ref name="Wizards" /> The [[Star system/Legends|system]] was located within the [[Sith Worlds/Legends|Sith Worlds]] region of the [[Esstran sector/Legends|Esstran sector]], in the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ashes of Korr was first mentioned in the first part of [[Korriban: Planet of Lost Souls]],<ref name="Wizards" /> a roleplaying supplement written by [[Cory J. Herndon]] and released on [[Wizards.com]]<ref name="Korriban">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20031002korriban|text=Korriban: Planet of Lost Souls}}</ref> on [[October 2]], [[2003]].<ref name="Wizards" /> ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]], and thus the system containing Ashes of Korr, in grid square R-5.<ref name="TEA" />
